data.content_ref: inline:Artifact 0e26d6be54fd integrates SRC_002 (v1.5 normative amendment) into the existing harness framework: it represents a concrete application or operationalization of the amendment's new rules, interfaces, or adjudication changes, bridging the normative layer of SRC_002 with the mechanical layer of SRC_003.
